acerca.intro: The district sets aside part of its budget for residents to decide. Anyone proposes, anyone votes, and the best-supported proposals are carried out until the money runs out.
acerca.paso1: Propose: mark on the map where the improvement would go and put a price on it.
acerca.paso3: Follow: results update live on this very site.
acerca.faq1r: Anyone registered in the district, at any age.
acerca.faq2: How much can I ask for?
acerca.faq2r: There is no minimum. Proposals above €200,000 go through a technical report.
acerca.faq3: What if my proposal does not win?
acerca.faq3r: It stays published and can be presented again in the next round.
acerca.faq4: Can I vote more than once?
acerca.faq4r: You may support as many proposals as you like, but each one only once.
